name: Can existing homes achieve green building standards?

mainEntity.name: Can existing homes achieve green building standards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through deep energy retrofits, insulation upgrades, window replacement, HVAC replacement, air sealing, and renewable energy to reach net-zero or passive house standards.
